components.label: Variants

components.notes: Options from listMessageTemplates filtered to the campaign's channel.

components.label: Add variant
components.notes: Adds an empty row; nothing is sent until Save.

components.label: Draft a variant with AI
components.notes: Drafts subject and body from a brief; the draft becomes a variant with source aiDraft only when the author saves it. AI drafts, a person applies (campaigns L2).

components.label: Test share of the audience (%)
components.notes: 5 to 100, default 20; 100 splits everyone and picks no winner.

components.label: Cancel
components.notes: Discards unsaved edits; nothing is sent.

components.label: Winning variant
components.notes: Shown when the winner rule is manual, or the automatic rule declared none because a variant is below the minimum sends. Options are the campaign's variants.

components.label: AI recommendations
components.notes: targetKind campaign, targetRef the campaignId. Uplift is shown as a range with its evidence; accepting one does not change the campaign (a person applies it).

components.label: Suggest a send time
components.notes: kind sendTime; the suggestion is shown beside the schedule and applied by a person.
